test_name: Configuration Management - CM-3 with Critical Cross-Cutting Failure
architecture:
System: Audit-Lake-053
Primary NIST family: Configuration Management (CM); evidence focus: CM-3.
Family control evidence: security-impacting configuration changes require review, approval, and traceable change records. Critical observed condition: an internal API transmits credentials over plaintext HTTP with TLS disabled. Other controls may be configured correctly, but the observed condition is current production evidence.
